Unison Blow.name: Unison Blow
Unison Blow.description: The user and a partner time their attacks, Quirks or gear into a single combined blow: wind feeding a fire, an impact shattering fresh ice, a hold pinning a target in front of a strike. The combination deals the damage types of both parts and breaks through a defense that could stop either part alone; any Quirk used in it still costs its usual Strain. Stamina: heavy.
